CustomField.formula:
IF( ISPICKVAL(PaymentStatus__c, "Paid"), IMAGE("/resource/1693905638000/GreenCircle", "Green", 15, 15) & " Paid",
IF( ISPICKVAL(PaymentStatus__c, "Un Paid"), IMAGE("/resource/1693905638000/RedCircle", "Red", 15, 15) & " Unpaid",
IF( ISPICKVAL(PaymentStatus__c, "Not Invoiced"), IMAGE("/resource/1693905638000/OrangeCircle", "Orange", 15, 15) & " Not Invoiced", IF( ISPICKVAL(PaymentStatus__c, "Reversed"), IMAGE("/resource/1693905638000/OrangeCircle", "Orange", 15, 15) & " Reversed", "" ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Payment Status
